Title: Bisq
Full description: Bisq is a fully open-source P2P Bitcoin exchange that runs as a distributed protocol on its users' machines. There is no company, no server, no account. Every trade happens directly between two parties locked into a 2-of-3 multisig escrow. SEPA, Revolut, cash by mail and dozens of other payment methods supported. Rated 100% Privacy / 95% Trust on kycnot.me.
What is it:
Bisq is the local market of Bitcoin: buyer and seller meet directly, no intermediary can block them, freeze funds or hand data to authorities. If every crypto exchange on earth disappeared tomorrow, Bisq would still run — because it runs on its users' computers, not on a server.

The security model is the key: both parties deposit a BTC bond into multisig before trading. Cheat and you lose the bond. No identity needed — the bond is the guarantee.
How it works:
1. Download Bisq from bisq.network — the app runs as a P2P node.

  2. Deposit a small BTC amount as a security bond into the internal wallet.

  3. Browse offers or create your own — specify payment method and price.

  4. BTC locks into 2-of-3 multisig during fiat payment window.

  5. Seller releases BTC once fiat payment is confirmed.

  6. Dispute resolution via community mediators if needed — no central authority.
When to use it:
• For any BTC purchase where KYC is a dealbreaker.

  • For medium-to-large amounts where ATM fees would be prohibitive.

  • When you want the highest trust-minimized P2P exchange available.

⚠️ Bisq requires BTC to start — get a small amount from an ATM first to cover the bond.

Title: Cake Pay
Description: Gift cards for 50,000+ brands, with XMR or BTC
Full description: Cake Pay (by Cake Wallet) sells gift cards for over 50,000 brands globally, with Monero (XMR) as the primary payment option alongside Bitcoin and Lightning. It's the most important real-world spending tool for Monero users — converting XMR directly into purchasing power at major retailers without going through any exchange or fiat conversion.
What is it:
Cake Pay is the spending layer for Monero. You acquired XMR for privacy — now what? You need to spend it somewhere. Cake Pay lets you buy gift cards for 50,000+ brands with XMR directly: grocery stores, electronics, hotels, flights, streaming services. Your Monero becomes real-world purchasing power without ever touching a bank, an exchange or a KYC process.

The breadth of 50,000+ brands includes international retailers rarely covered by competitors. For Monero holders, this is the most practical tool for making XMR useful in daily life.
How it works:
1. Download Cake Wallet (which includes Cake Pay) or go to cakepay.com.

  2. Browse the brand catalog — filter by category or country.

  3. Select denomination and pay with XMR or BTC.

  4. Receive the gift card code instantly.

  5. Use in-store or online at the retailer.
When to use it:
• As the primary spending tool for Monero — broadest brand coverage for XMR payments.

  • For travel: hotel and airline gift cards purchasable with XMR.

  • To close the loop on a full privacy cycle: no-KYC buy → XMR → Cake Pay spend.

Title: RoboSats
Description: P2P Lightning exchange with robot identities
Full description: RoboSats is a P2P Bitcoin exchange built on Lightning Network. Each user is a randomly generated robot — no registration, no email, no trace. Trades settle on Lightning in minutes instead of Bisq's hours. Federated architecture means multiple operators run independent instances — if one is blocked, others keep running. Rated 99% Privacy / 97% Trust on kycnot.me.
What is it:
RoboSats solved Bisq's main friction: speed. Where Bisq uses on-chain Bitcoin and can take hours, RoboSats settles on Lightning in minutes. Your identity is a robot generated locally from a random token — no server has ever seen your real credentials.

The federated model is the resilience layer: no single RoboSats instance can be shut down permanently because any operator can run a new one. This is what decentralization actually looks like in practice.
How it works:
1. Go to robosats.com or use the .onion address via Tor, or the Android app.

  2. A robot is automatically generated — save the recovery token, it's your only access key.

  3. Browse or post an offer — specify amount, price and fiat payment method.

  4. Bond locks via Lightning invoice — forfeit if you abandon the trade.

  5. After fiat payment, satoshis arrive instantly in your Lightning wallet.
When to use it:
• For fast no-KYC purchases under 0.01 BTC — Lightning speed is the advantage.

  • When Bisq's hours-long wait is too slow for your situation.

  • As your first no-KYC exchange — simpler UX than Bisq.

Best used via Tor Browser for maximum anonymity — the .onion address is the correct entry point.

Title: Peach Bitcoin
Description: Mobile P2P app for BTC in Europe
Full description: Peach Bitcoin is a Swiss mobile P2P app focused on the European market. No account required. Accepts SEPA transfers, Revolut, Satispay and other common European payment methods. Multisig escrow protects both parties. The most accessible no-KYC entry point for Italian and EU users who want to buy Bitcoin from their phone without installing desktop software.
What is it:
Peach is the mobile-first no-KYC option built for Europe. If Bisq is the advanced desktop tool, Peach is the app that feels familiar — swipe through offers, choose a payment method you already use, complete the trade. The security model is the same multisig escrow underneath.

It works more like a dating app than an exchange: offers are matched by location and payment preference, not displayed as a public order book. Simple by design.
How it works:
1. Download Peach Bitcoin from the app store.

  2. No registration required — the app generates a key pair locally.

  3. Choose your preferred payment method (SEPA, Revolut, Satispay, cash).

  4. Browse offers matched to your location and payment preference.

  5. BTC goes into Peach escrow — released when payment is confirmed.

  6. Withdraw directly to your self-custody wallet.
When to use it:
• As the first no-KYC purchase for Italian/EU users — the payment methods are the ones you already use.

  • When you want mobile-only without installing Bisq's desktop client.

  • For small-to-medium amounts with familiar fiat payment rails.

Title: HodlHodl
Full description: HodlHodl is a non-custodial P2P exchange active since 2016, based in Latvia. It never holds user funds — trades happen through auto-generated 2-of-3 multisig escrow between the two parties. Web-based, no software to install. Also offers P2P lending: use Bitcoin as collateral to borrow stablecoins without selling or showing documents to any bank.
What is it:
HodlHodl is the veteran — been running since 2016 when most other no-KYC options didn't exist. Web-based means no installation: create an account with just an email (optional), find an offer, trade. The lending side is its unique contribution to the space: BTC as collateral for USDT without KYC, without a bank, without selling your stack.

The reputational system built over 9 years of operation makes it one of the most trustworthy P2P options for larger amounts.
How it works:
1. Go to hodlhodl.com — register with optional email.

  2. Browse offers or create your own with any agreed payment method.

  3. An auto-generated multisig escrow locks BTC during fiat payment.

  4. For lending: deposit BTC as collateral, receive USDT, repay to reclaim BTC.

  5. Reputation score (completed trades) increases offer visibility and trust.
When to use it:
• For no-KYC purchases via web without desktop software.

  • For P2P BTC-collateral lending — borrow stablecoins without selling Bitcoin.

  • For international trades with payment methods not on Bisq or Peach.

Title: Bittr
Description: Buy BTC, no KYC up to €900/day
Full description: Bittr (getbittr.com) is a Swiss Bitcoin-only service that lets you buy BTC via SEPA bank transfer with no KYC required for amounts up to €900/day (CHF 1,000). You register with just an email, your IBAN and a Bitcoin wallet address. Send a bank transfer, and Bittr converts it to BTC and sends it directly to your wallet — no exchange account, no custodial holding, no account login. Fee: 1.5% flat (+ €1 for amounts under €100). Supports recurring transfers for automated DCA. Regulated in Switzerland by VQF. Transactions batch every 4 hours to minimize on-chain fees.
What is it:
Bittr is the Swiss bank transfer that arrives in Bitcoin. You set up a standing order in your online banking — weekly, monthly, or whenever you want — and every time the transfer lands at Bittr, BTC appears in your wallet automatically. No exchange account to log into. No dashboard to monitor. No exchange that holds your coins. Just a bank transfer that turns into self-custody Bitcoin.

The Swiss VQF regulation is a meaningful signal: Bittr operates under a real legal framework, not from an anonymous island jurisdiction. Light-KYC means they know your IBAN and email — not your passport, not your face, not your home address. For daily amounts under €900, that's the full extent of the relationship.
How it works:
1. Go to getbittr.com and register with your email, IBAN and Bitcoin wallet address.

  2. Bittr sends you a unique reference code and their bank details.

  3. In your online banking, set up a single or recurring SEPA transfer using that reference.

  4. When Bittr receives the transfer, BTC is sent directly to your wallet — no login needed.

  5. Transactions batch every 4 hours to minimize on-chain fees.

  6. You receive an email notification every time BTC arrives in your wallet.

⚠️ No Lightning Network support — BTC is sent on-chain only. Don't send EUR to the CHF account or vice versa — transfers in the wrong currency are rejected with additional bank fees.
When to use it:
• For automated no-KYC DCA (Dollar Cost Averaging) — set it once from your bank and forget it.

  • When you want BTC delivered directly to cold storage without touching any exchange.

  • For EU users who prefer SEPA bank transfer over P2P platforms — familiar, fast, clean.

  • For amounts under €900/day where the light-KYC threshold is not exceeded.

Bittr is the easiest no-KYC Bitcoin buying method for European users with a bank account — no app to install, no exchange to trust with custody, no dashboard to check.
